channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's curated vulnerabilities highlight a severe threat landscape dominated by remote code execution and privilege escalation flaws across critical enterprise infrastructure, with Microsoft products and services representing the largest share of risk. Significant findings include widespread memory corruption issues in Windows components like DNS, LDAP, and Print Spooler, alongside dangerous deserialization and command injection vulnerabilities in cloud platforms such as Azure and container registries like Red Hat Quay. The day's data also reveals extensive weaknesses in industrial control systems and IoT devices, where missing authentication and hardcoded credentials enable unauthenticated device takeovers, while database engines including SQL Server and PostgreSQL face sandbox escapes that allow arbitrary code execution at the operating system level.
